title: Innokin Coolfire P60 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Coolfire P60 Pod Vape Kit brings impressive battery life and versatile performance to an ultra-slim device. Featuring a large 3200mAh built-in battery, the Coolfire P60 offers up to 60W of adjustable power in a body that’s lightweight, stylish, and highly portable. Designed to accommodate multiple vaping styles, the P60 is compatible with Innokin’s PZP Max coil range, including 0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, and 0.8ohm resistances. Whether you prefer a mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, a restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vape, or a more open direct-to-lung (DTL) experience, the Coolfire P60 adapts to your preferences. Side airflow control allows for precise tuning, while the smart chipset ensures consistent power delivery—even as the battery runs low. The 2ml refillable pods are simple to top up thanks to an easy-access top-fill mechanism, and the manual lock switch adds a layer of safety when carrying the device. A crisp 0.69-inch OLED screen displays all your settings at a glance, and fast USB-C charging helps minimise downtime. With its soft leather grip, clean metal detailing and slim profile, the Coolfire P60 offers premium performance in a compact, practical format—ideal for everyday vaping across all coil preferences and vaping styles. Shop our vape liquids today and find blends crafted to complement this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
